title: this weekend
excerpt: I’ll be in Indianapolis doing our very last EMC tour event … it’s not too late to register. Just sign up here. I’ll also be at the Spirit and Place festival on Sunday and Butler University on Monday. I hope to see many of you in Indiana this weekend!
body:
I’ll be in Indianapolis doing our very last EMC tour event … it’s not too late to register. Just sign up here.

 I’ll also be at the Spirit and Place festival on Sunday and Butler University on Monday. I hope to see many of you in Indiana this weekend!
